In a studio audience of 100 people, 40% of these people have an envelope taped underneath their chairs.  20% of these people will have "You Won" in their envelope, the rest will have empty envelopes.  How many people will win a prize?

First, we calculate the number of people who have an envelope taped underneath their chairs. This is 40% of 100 people:
\[ 0.40 \times 100 = 40 \text{ people} \]

Next, we determine how many of these 40 people will have "You Won" in their envelope. This is 20% of the 40 people:
\[ 0.20 \times 40 = 8 \text{ people} \]

Therefore, 8 people will win a prize.

FINAL: 8
